app.metadataDescription: Open-source, self-hosted HR e-sign platform: PDF templates, approval-before-seal, handwritten signing, external candidate links, and full audit archives.
app.metadataKeywords: e-sign,electronic seal,HR signing,self-hosted,open source,HRSign,PDF signature,approval workflow
app.ogTitle: HRSign — HR e-Sign & Company Seal Workflow
app.ogDescription: Open-source signing for offers, contracts, and certificates. Self-hosted data, approval before seal, end-to-end audit trail.
